title: Kafka source and sink configuration
description: Kafka connection, consumer, and producer settings for one shared Tenon Plugin owner.

clientId.description: Optional Kafka client identifier shared by this Plugin instance.

saslMechanism.description: Kafka SASL mechanism, such as PLAIN or SCRAM-SHA-512.

saslJaasConfig.description: Kafka JAAS client configuration. Tenon currently passes this value as plain Plugin configuration.

sslTruststoreLocation.description: Absolute path to the Kafka client truststore.

sslTruststorePassword.description: Kafka truststore password passed as plain Plugin configuration.

sslKeystoreLocation.description: Absolute path to the Kafka client keystore.

sslKeystorePassword.description: Kafka keystore password passed as plain Plugin configuration.

sslKeyPassword.description: Kafka private key password passed as plain Plugin configuration.

sourceTopics.description: Kafka topics consumed by the Source interface.

sourceConsumerCount.description: Number of Kafka consumers in this Source consumer group. Defaults to 1.

autoOffsetReset.description: Initial position when the consumer group has no committed offset.

pollTimeoutMs.description: Maximum duration of one Kafka consumer poll in milliseconds.

maxPollRecords.description: Maximum Kafka records returned by one poll.

defaultTopic.description: Kafka topic used by the Sink when a payload omits its topic.

acks.description: Kafka producer acknowledgement policy required by idempotence.

enableIdempotence.description: Kafka producer idempotence remains enabled for this delivery profile.

batchSize.description: Target producer batch size in bytes.

deliveryTimeoutMs.description: Upper bound for Kafka producer delivery in milliseconds.
